dedupe_keys.name: small reactors in microgrids technoeconomic analysis idaho national laboratory august 2022

description: This case study is an August 2022 Idaho National Laboratory technical report on small modular reactors and microreactors, called small reactors, in microgrids, written with Reilly Associates and XENDEE Corporation. It presents a technoeconomic analysis using a proxy model for small reactors in microgrids built from data points identified in a predecessor report, Small Reactors in Microgrids: Technical Studies Guidance. The results and comparative analysis show that small reactors could be a cost-competitive generation option when capital costs are modelled with potential economies of scale in sizing, and that they would be even more attractive than gas generators if a CO2 tax were imposed on carbon fuels, so they could reduce the carbon footprint at the local distribution level. The report cautions that the most suitable use cases for early adoption and the right generation mix with other clean technologies must be identified as small reactors reach technological and financial maturity. Access: OSTI technical report, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: a proxy model, not a specific site design. It suits investment appraisal and capacity planning studies for microgrids, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
